## What it is

Number 2, rendered yellow. Front-left, 225°. Recessed 2. Four clips on the 965.2 mm tube, one quarter turn after the start tower.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side.
- The foot is the same 6.0 × 3.2 mm tab as the other towers. The 2 is recessed into the top face of the rib.
- The spoke is 4.29 mm along the tower. The 2.15 mm 45° gussets stay inside the rib. The slope starts at the outer face.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't swap it with number 1. The tab fits every slot. The clips would no longer be one helix.
